findings.description: TIAT, an art gallery, now occupies a former JINS eyewear storefront at 151 Powell Street in Union Square, taken on through the SF New Deal's Vacant to Vibrant program. The high-ceilinged space, with the small back rooms that once held optometry appointments, now hosts light-and-shadow installations. The article does not say when the lease expires or what happens after.

findings.description: A town hall of about 60 Richmond District neighbors opposed the eight-story, 562-unit Safeway redevelopment at 850 La Playa Street, objecting to the state streamlining laws that bypass discretionary review. The project's own facts — 562 units, 113 affordable, 85 feet, Align Real Estate for owner Albertsons, Steinberg Hart as architect — are already on this page from the formal application (sfyimby, 18 May 2026). This story adds neighborhood reaction, not a new building fact.

citation.label: Mission Local, “At Richmond District town hall on Safeway housing project, neighbors see an assault on democracy,” 25 September 2026
